title: Unrestricted `diamondCut` allows unauthorized facet modifications
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  ## Description  The `SimplexDiamond` contract includes `DiamondCutFacet.diamondCut.selector` in its selectors. This function allows adding, removing, or modifying facet cuts, which determine the contract’s functionality. However, **this function is not restricted**, meaning **anyone** can call it to remove or replace any selector or facet.  ### **Proof of Concept (PoC)**  The test case below demonstrates how a random user can call `diamondCut` to remove or modify contract functionality, potentially leading to loss of control
